integrity: The claim is proved algebraically from conditioning and a neighboring-binomial-mass ratio. Exact rational computations are supplied only as stress tests and are not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification is for the two-added-trial step only; no sharp formula is claimed for larger block sizes. Older related full texts were not all directly inspectable, leaving a bounded residual originality risk.
title: Sharp success-probability threshold for the two-trial Chaundy–Bullard step
